pay.label: Pay
pay.source: ONS ASHE Table 14.7a, 2025 provisional (full-time gross annual)
pay.caveat: Suppressed where the sample is too small (30 of 412 occupations).

supply.label: People entering each year
supply.source: HESA Table 52 undergraduate entrants allocated to occupations via Graduate Outcomes SB275 Figure 12 shares; DfE apprenticeship starts
supply.caveat: Figure 12 shares are rounded to whole percent and are measured at SOC major-group level; within a group we split by employment size.

exposure.label: AI exposure
exposure.source: Eloundou et al. (2023), 'GPTs are GPTs': human-rated E1/E2 exposure of 19,265 O*NET task statements, aggregated to SOC2020 via the NFER crosswalk
exposure.caveat: US task ratings collected in 2023, applied to UK occupations; they measure how much of the work a language model could do, not whether the job goes away.

nowcast.label: Hiring vs pre-2023 trend
nowcast.source: Advert share of all UK adverts vs its Jan 2018 - Nov 2022 linear trend, COVID months (Mar 2020 - Jun 2021) excluded
nowcast.caveat: A z-score against that trend's own variability. Adverts are an early signal, not employment.

competition.label: Entrants per opening
competition.source: Projected entrants divided by projected annual openings (NFER Skills Imperative 2035 expansion + Census-based replacement)
competition.caveat: Skills Imperative projections predate the LLM shock and are used deliberately as the no-AI baseline; bands are Monte Carlo.

meta.no_composite_note: Indicators are published separately and never combined into a single score.
